messages:
Alex: FYI I rolled heuristic_v2 kernel-picker to canary last night; seeing p95 decode increase on host-proxy for small-reqs (~+12%). digging. :grimacing:
Sara: yikes. which stage looks hot?
Alex: traces point to parsing/tokenization. perf top shows `tokenizer::scan_chars` ~32%, `grpc::writev_serialize` ~10%, `kvcache::lookup` ~8%.
Jamal: did the rollout change host preparse budget?
Alex: yes, `host_preparse_budget_ms` dropped 6->3 alongside kernel-picker flip.
Chris: ran pprof on canary: lots of tiny allocations in tokenizer during stream chunking. writev calls spiking -> http2 frames smaller than before.
infra-bot: alert: canary group small_write_pct rose 18%->41% between 02:10-03:00 UTC (ingress-metrics).
Irene: kv metrics also show eviction rate up, kv-hit down 0.94->0.86. could be churn from picking different kernel variant with v2.
Sara: logs show big variance in token_scan_us per request, sample:
```
[2026-03-22T02:14:11Z] req=abcd parse_ms=2 decode_ms=6 token_scan_us=1200 kv_lookup_us=80 writev_calls=4 total_ms=18
[2026-03-22T02:14:12Z] req=abce parse_ms=1 decode_ms=12 token_scan_us=3200 kv_lookup_us=90 writev_calls=7 total_ms=27
```
Alex: plan: revert preparse budget to baseline on canary and run microbench matrix to isolate effects.
Jamal: running bench script: kernel_picker v1/v2 x preparse 3/6 x batch size 4/8, collecting perf/pprof/tcpdump. cmd:
```
./benchctl run --suite smallreq-mix --kernel-picker v1,v2 --batch-sizes 4,8 --preparse-budget 3,6 --measure perf,pprof,kvstats --capture tcpdump
```
Chris: tcpdump sample shows many ~1-2KB frames for v2+budget=3 vs coalesced ~8-12KB for baseline. explains writev count increase.
Jamal: quick run results:
- v2 + budget=3 + batch=8: p95 +12%
- v1 + budget=3 + batch=8: p95 +3%
- v2 + budget=6 + batch=8: p95 +4%
- v2 + budget=3 + batch=4: p95 +1%
Irene: seems budget cut is main culprit; batching also interacts.
Sara: mitigation: rollback budget to 6, keep heuristic_v2 but add guard to avoid switching kernels for seq_len < 64. also consider tokenizer buffer pool to avoid repeated allocs.
Alex: PR opened to rollback budget to canary: https://git.internal/r/rollout/1234. applying now.
perf-bot: perf job queued: smallreq-mix job id 9582. artifacts when ready.
Jamal: perf artifacts uploaded: https://perf.internal/artifacts/9582.zip (pprof flamegraphs + tcpdump). ticket INF-762 created with details.
Irene: after rollback applied to canary p95 returned to baseline; small_write_pct back to ~20%; kv-hit recovered to 0.93.
Chris: follow-ups: tokenizer pool PR, kernel-picker guard for small sequences, and additional A/B on batch sizes across client mixes.
Alex: assigning: Jamal -> tokenizer pool PR; Chris -> kernel-picker guard; Sara/Irene -> AB tests. add writeup to postmortem in #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
